newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD SALE RESULTS APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-RIGA SHIPYARD SALE RESULTS APPROVED.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) said on Tuesday that it confirmed the results of the auction of shares in Riga Shipyard, sold for cash at 1.39 lats a share on April 14.
LPA confirmed the price of 1.39 lats and the number of shares sold at 837,140 lats, it said in a statement.
The agency earlier set the minimum price for the 8.37 percent of the shipyard stake at 837,140 shares at 1.30 lats.
Riga Shipyard management now has to decide, which of the Riga stock exchange lists to join.
The bourse earlier said that it would be a matter of a week at most for the company to begin trading on the exchange.
